title: software-change-delivery-result-v1
description: ResultEnvelope shape a Worker submits for a software-change-delivery Task. The authoritative producer of each field is the role that owns the taskKind; the Leader records accept/revision/blocked decisions, never a Worker.

changeRevisionRef.description: Required for implement and release tasks: the sealed artifact reference the Assessor verifies and the Operator deploys.

claim.description: Professional claim text. A claim is never Evidence by itself.

completionContractDigest.description: Echo of the Task binding's completion contract; must match for the Result to count.

blocker.description: Set only when the Worker cannot proceed; forces a BLOCKED transition.
